name: Unsloth
summary: Open-source LLM fine-tuning library and desktop app for running and training models locally, with a dual Apache-2.0 / AGPL-3.0 license split.
description: Established project (GitHub since 2023; not a 2026 launch; not archived). Core Python package on PyPI as unsloth (2026.11.3 verified 2026-11-10), installable with `uv pip install unsloth --torch-backend=auto`. The README also documents a native desktop app (downloads, Homebrew cask, Winget, Docker image unsloth/unsloth) plus install.sh/install.ps1 scripts. Dual licensing per README: core package Apache-2.0; optional Unsloth Studio UI components under AGPL-3.0 (studio/LICENSE.AGPL-3.0). GPU/model weights and any hosted extras are separate. Do not treat marketing 'first desktop app' wording as an independently verified industry-first claim.

agent_access.notes: Public source and PyPI package. Desktop/app installers and Docker are documented on unsloth.ai/docs. Model weights and GPUs are separate.
